newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Ex-managing director buys Scotts shares.
newsitem.headline: Ex-managing director buys Scotts shares.

text.p: Former managing dirctor of Scotts Holdings Ltd Rafiq Jumabhoy has bought 12.95 million shares in the company, said a statement from Rafiq's lawyers late on Tuesday.

Rafiq, who is in the midst of a court battle with other members of his family for control of Scotts, signed an agreement to buy the shares from Scotts Investment Singapore (SIS) at Singapore $0.85 cents each, the statement said.
The purchase, which would give Rafiq a 5.47 percent stake in Scotts, is being made through Heslop International.
SIS is the Jumabhoy's family holding company, which controls Scotts.
Rafiq's option to buy 100 million Scotts shares belonging to the Jumabhoy family is currently the main subject of a legal battle being fought in the Singapore High Court.
